title: ToolsetConfiguration
description: Schema definition for automated toolset configurations and local runtime parameters.

tools.description: List of active tools and execution wrappers enabled in this toolset.

name.description: Unique identifier or name of the tool.

enabled.description: Indicates whether the tool is active.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum execution duration allowed for the tool.

parameters.description: Key-value configuration parameters passed to the tool.
